scope: Same 84-record black-stroke SVG-to-PDF and pinned host-Mesa alpha frame as pencil2-v14-svg-pdf-control.json, rendered with transparent output at integer multiples of 192x192 then averaged in nonoverlapping blocks to 192x192. This is a reader-side rasterization experiment, not a vector-paint correction.
limitations: The SVG prototype and native frame are retained under tmp/vector-parity-plan; runner and dependencies are described in pencil2-v14-svg-pdf-control.json.
Supersampling reduces errors but leaves substantial discrepancies and excess support at 8x. It does not identify their causes or establish convergence.
One synthetic stroke, scale and host only; no saved-note, Android, arbitrary-color or production parity.
